label: He says he was told Saturday before the American strike on Iran
description: He says the Lord told him Saturday three times, that he saw America striking Iran on the Saturday in the middle of the night, and that the reason given was it would not happen while the stock market was open. He also says in the same session that he never relayed that publicly because he filters what he says on a live stream, which is the point at issue: the specific version he claims credit for was by his own account not said in advance. The strike was on 21 June 2025.
aliases: the Lord said Saturday, Saturday, Saturday
it came to pass today, Saturday

label: Drones over golf courses aimed at the president
description: Drones flying in over certain places to hurt the president while he is playing golf. He raises the radar and Secret Service objection himself and leaves it unanswered, guessing stealth or high altitude.

label: Israel holds technology nobody else knows about
description: Israel holding hidden technological advancements nobody in the world has, which he says the American government did not know about under the previous administration and Trump barely knows about, with the pager operation cited as an example of how deep it goes.
aliases: The United States of America doesn't even know

label: Explosions on the sun and a changed solar cycle
description: Explosions and flares on the sun with something different in its cycle, given as the content of the fearful sights in the heavens he had been promised, alongside the shaking of the powers of heaven.

label: A 9.0 in California
description: The Californian earthquake described as bad, like 9.0, set against the New Madrid where he sees only fours and fives on a waking fault. The San Andreas cannot physically produce a 9.0; its estimated maximum is near 8.3, which makes the number wrong for the fault he names.
aliases: the one out in California was was bad like 9.0

label: No sick people at all in the last generation
description: As with Israel leaving Egypt there will be no feeble one among the bride leaving this earth, no sick people, to the point a person would have to resist being healed. The if you just believe me for it clause places any failure on the person rather than on the word.
aliases: there will be no feeble among you
You will have to resist healing
if you just believe me for it

label: Raising the dead becomes the status quo
description: Raising the dead becoming ordinary rather than exceptional, along with arms and legs growing out and eyes coming back where there were none. He notes himself that these are reported overseas and not in America, which is the pattern that would have to change.
aliases: Why can't it be the norm to raise the dead?
arms growing out and legs growing out

label: Believers maturing virtually overnight
description: Read aloud from an older prophecy: believers maturing virtually overnight and learning spiritual things far faster than previous generations because the time is short, which he applies to new converts being qualified immediately. He is reading a text here rather than reporting a word, which he marks by pausing to comment.

label: Iranian leaders fleeing north to Moscow
description: Strategic Iranian leaders fleeing north toward Moscow and others toward Iraq, abandoning ship and afraid for their lives because of the deaths. Given in the present tense during the June 2025 war, which makes it checkable against reporting from that week.
aliases: I see strategic leaders trying to flee Iran right now

label: A sniper in the Denver area exposed and reported in the news
description: Prayer that the sniper on the building in the Denver area be exposed and taken down and that it appear in the news, explicitly so that viewers can see visible fruit of the prayers. A request for confirmation rather than a prediction, which is worth keeping separate.
aliases: the sniper on the building's exposed
a man in Colorado was taken down in Denver area

label: Seed time and harvest shortens into seed harvest
description: Time shortened so that seed time and harvest becomes seed harvest with no interval, given alongside judgment beginning in the house of the Lord and compromise being cleared out.
aliases: it will be seed harvest, seed harvest
seed, time and harvest is accelerating

label: Preachers going home in the pulpit like Ananias and Sapphira
description: Preachers dying in the pulpit in the middle of the manifestation, because of what they sowed, on the Ananias and Sapphira pattern, as compromise is cleared out of the house of God.
aliases: get compromise out of the house of God

label: Turkey, Pakistan and Afghanistan upset about the strikes
description: Turkey, Pakistan and Afghanistan seen upset about the strikes on Iran, with the explicit caveat that he is not saying they are part of Ezekiel 38 and 39. Worth recording because he marks the limit of his own claim, which he rarely does.
aliases: I saw Turkey I saw Pakistan
I'm not saying they're a part of Ezekiel 38:39
very upset about what happened today
